contexts.text: The ideas of thought take one another up so quickly...
Whosoever shall not receive you... ()... Not to receive = to reject the truths of faith.
Admonishing me to receive them well... But with me all are received according to what they are. AC 8028.
He is then received by good Spirits...
When a man enters the other life, he is first received by Angels...
In his own Hell, a Spirit is at first received in a friendly manner...
The atmosphere takes the Sun into its bosom.
